title: Validate with reasons
prompt: Implement `static AddResult Validate(Transaction t)` — reject when Amount <= 0 ("amount-must-be-positive"), when Category is null/whitespace ("category-required"), or when Description exceeds 100 characters ("description-too-long"); otherwise Ok with Error null.

tests.name: normal
rejections
tests.hint: Each rejection reason is pinned; rule order matters (amount first); a 60-char description must stay valid while 101 chars must not.
